title: 南京主城景点与主要道路布局 v2
scope: 主城景点视口；不是南京全市行政地图
projection: WGS84 → Web Mercator local pixels (z12, origin tile 3398/1661)
scene_mapping: X=(source_px.x-350)*3.24; Y=0; Z=(source_px.y-430)*3.24. 1 unit ≈10m at Nanjing latitude. North = -Z. Heights independent.
geometry_notes: Roads and lake rings from OSM API; roads simplified with 0.45 source-pixel tolerance (~15m). Dual carriageways retained. Rivers use OSM centerlines with illustrative width. Yangtze/islands/mountain are inherited hand-simplified v1 shapes, not survey boundaries. POIs have zero artistic shift; public source coordinates may represent a site centre rather than an entrance.
